description: This file defines a PHP class 'PartialJobSpecificationAttachment' within the 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto' namespace. The class models a data transfer object that encapsulates attributes related to a job specification attachment, including ID, filename, file type, file size, and job title ID. It provides a constructor and getter methods for each attribute.

classes.name: PartialJobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a partial job specification attachment with properties for ID, filename, file type, size, and associated job title ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class with specified attribute values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the associated job title ID.
